subject: Customer Satisfaction Survey Guidelines and QA Compliance

bodies.text:
Dear Team,
Please ensure that agents do not mislead vendors regarding customer satisfaction surveys during calls made as follow-ups to chats.
Agents must not instruct vendors to give a 5-star rating or ask them to rate the agent with 5 stars. Instead, agents should communicate the standard survey information neutrally and professionally, without influencing the vendor's rating.
Please note that any misleading behavior or violation of these instructions may result in an abuse escalation email, and the related chat will receive a QA score of 0.

Amir Ali

Quality Assurance Analyst | Teleperformance | M +01090097684 | Cairo, Egypt | amir.taha@tp.com

subject: Compensation Process – Full Guidelines & Handling Procedure

bodies.text:
Dear Team,
As part of our continuous efforts to improve the vendor experience and ensure proper handling of compensation inquiries, please be reminded that when reviewing a compensation request that has been rejected, the rejection reason must be checked before providing a response to the vendor.
Required Actions:
If the compensation request was rejected due to insufficient, unclear, or missing evidence, agents should ask the vendor to provide additional or clearer supporting evidence and advise them that the case can be reviewed further once the required documents are available then escalate the case to the dispute team on CCR Payment Reconciliation.
If the compensation request was rejected because it did not meet the required quality standards, agents should apologize to the vendor and explain that no further action can be taken as the request has already been reviewed based on the approved quality standards.


Please review the attached emails regarding the Compensation process and ensure full adherence to the outlined guidelines and handling procedures moving forward.

Dear Team,
As part of our continuous efforts to improve the vendor experience and ensure proper handling of compensation inquiries, please be reminded that when reviewing a compensation request that has been rejected, the rejection reason must be checked before providing a response to the vendor.
Required Actions:
  • If the compensation request was rejected due to insufficient, unclear, or missing evidence, agents should ask the vendor to provide additional or clearer supporting evidence and advise them that the case can be reviewed further once the required documents are available then escalate the case to the dispute team on CCR Payment Reconciliation.
  • If the compensation request was rejected because it did not meet the required quality standards, agents should apologize to the vendor and explain that no further action can be taken as the request has already been reviewed based on the approved quality standards.

Please review the attached emails regarding the Compensation process and ensure full adherence to the outlined guidelines and handling procedures moving forward.

مع خالص التحية والتقدير،

subject: Logo and Cover Photo Guidelines

bodies.text:
Hello Team,

 

Please note that for any updates to the Logo, Listing Image, we need to keep the following in consideration:

 

Logo Standards:

 

The photo size must be 800*800
centered in the middle
High resolution (clear and not blurry)
should not contain any black areas
No contacts number or social media account.
it should contain the same name of the restaurant ( account name)

 

Cover Photo Standards:

 

The photo size must be 1500*750
High resolution image
Landscape format
Should reflect the brand or food type
No price or offer in the same photo. 

 

Do not use any photo before it meets the standard. Once approved, resize it using https://bulkresizephotos.com/en and then update it accordingly. 

 

 

 

Amir Ali

Hello Team,

 

Please note that for any updates to the Logo, Listing Image, we need to keep the following in consideration:

 

Logo Standards:

 

  • The photo size must be 800*800
  • centered in the middle
  • High resolution (clear and not blurry)
  • should not contain any black areas
  • No contacts number or social media account.
  • it should contain the same name of the restaurant ( account name)

 

Cover Photo Standards:

 

  • The photo size must be 1500*750
  • High resolution image
  • Landscape format
  • Should reflect the brand or food type
  • No price or offer in the same photo. 

 

  • Do not use any photo before it meets the standard. Once approved, resize it using https://bulkresizephotos.com/en and then update it accordingly.

bodies.text:
Dear Team,


Kindly ensure that the approved macro standards are followed and that no additional sentences are included unless they are aligned with HungerStation standards.


Please also ensure that all macros are written in a clear and professional manner, as they are considered official communication that will be sent directly to the vendor.

subject: Call Ringing Guidelines for Partners, Riders, and Customers

bodies.text:
Dear Team,
Please be reminded of the proper ringing time when contacting partners, riders, and customers to ensure they are given enough time to answer the call.
Ringing Guidelines:
Partners & Riders: The call should be allowed to ring normally and should not be ended before 30 seconds. This does not mean you should stop the call at 30 seconds ,let the call ring fully as Ending the call in less than 30 seconds will be considered a behavior issue and may impact the QA score.
Customers: The call should ring for at least 3 rings before ending the attempt.
These guidelines aim to ensure fair call attempts and provide all parties with sufficient time to respond.
Thank you for your cooperation.





Amir Ali

Subject: Call Ringing Guidelines for Partners, Riders, and Customers
 
Dear Team,
Please be reminded of the proper ringing time when contacting partners, riders, and customers to ensure they are given enough time to answer the call.
Ringing Guidelines:
  • Partners & Riders: The call should be allowed to ring normally and should not be ended before 30 seconds. This does not mean you should stop the call at 30 seconds ,let the call ring fully as Ending the call in less than 30 seconds will be considered a behavior issue and may impact the QA score.
  • Customers: The call should ring for at least 3 rings before ending the attempt.
These guidelines aim to ensure fair call attempts and provide all parties with sufficient time to respond.
Thank you for your cooperation.


Amir Ali

Quality Assurance Analyst | Teleperformance | M +01090097684 | Cairo, Egypt | amir.taha@teleperformance.com

Subject: Call Ringing Guidelines for Partners, Riders, and Customers
 
Dear Team,
Please be reminded of the proper ringing time when contacting partners, riders, and customers to ensure they are given enough time to answer the call.
Ringing Guidelines:
  • Partners & Riders: The call should be allowed to ring normally and should not be ended before 30 seconds. This does not mean you should stop the call at 30 seconds ,let the call ring fully as Ending the call in less than 30 seconds will be considered a behavior issue and may impact the QA score.
  • Customers: The call should ring for at least 3 rings before ending the attempt.
These guidelines aim to ensure fair call attempts and provide all parties with sufficient time to respond.
Thank you for your cooperation.


Amir Ali

subject: Handling Onboarding Team Tickets

bodies.text:
Dear Team,

Hope this finds you well.

 

I’d like to share with you the correct process for handling and resolving tickets received from the Onboarding Team :

 

Check the ticket details carefully
At the top of each ticket, you’ll find the Grid, Vendor name. The first step is to make sure to add the Correct Vendor ID.

 

Contact the vendor
Each ticket contains a phone number for the vendor. We must call the vendor to check the issue and resolve it directly.
If the vendor does not answer, we should resolve the issue through the Macro reply.

 

Include the ticket number
At the end of the macro, make sure to mention the Ticket ID clearly.

 

Always add the vendor’s email
The vendor’s email should be taken from the Operation Portal. If you send your reply without including the vendor’s email, your response will not reach him.

 

The three Onboarding Team emails are :
• malak.alshawabkeh.ext@hungerstation.com
• kayed.khraisat.ext@hungerstation.com
• salahaldeen.aldebei.ext@hungerstation.com

 

 

When they send a ticket, they usually put the Hungerstation client email as well.

 

Let’s all ensure we follow these steps consistently so that vendors receive accurate and timely support.

 

 

Amir Ali

Subject: Handling Onboarding Team Tickets

 

Dear Team,

Hope this finds you well.

 

I’d like to share with you the correct process for handling and resolving tickets received from the Onboarding Team :

 

  • Check the ticket details carefully
  • At the top of each ticket, you’ll find the Grid, Vendor name. The first step is to make sure to add the Correct Vendor ID.

 

  • Contact the vendor
  • Each ticket contains a phone number for the vendor. We must call the vendor to check the issue and resolve it directly.
  • If the vendor does not answer, we should resolve the issue through the Macro reply.

 

  • Include the ticket number
  • At the end of the macro, make sure to mention the Ticket ID clearly.

 

  • Always add the vendor’s email
  • The vendor’s email should be taken from the Operation Portal. If you send your reply without including the vendor’s email, your response will not reach him.

 

  • The three Onboarding Team emails are :
    • malak.alshawabkeh.ext@hungerstation.com
    • kayed.khraisat.ext@hungerstation.com
    • salahaldeen.aldebei.ext@hungerstation.com

 

 

When they send a ticket, they usually put the Hungerstation client email as well.

 

Let’s all ensure we follow these steps consistently so that vendors receive accurate and timely support.

 

 

Amir Ali

subject: Avoid Repeating Previous Responses or Reusing the Same Macros

bodies.text:
Hello team,


We have recently noticed several cases where agents repeated the exact same response provided by a previous agent or copied and pasted the same macro without adding any new value or taking further action.
Please note that repeating the same response without progressing the case leads to a poor customer experience and may result in a DSAT classified as Agent Related. Additionally, this behavior will negatively impact your QA score under the relevant quality attributes.
We have also noticed that some vendors have started recognizing these repetitive responses and have commented that the replies appear to be AI-generated rather than written by a support agent.
Before replying to any vendor, please make sure to:
Review the full ticket history.
Avoid sending the same macro or repeating a previous response unless there is new information to share.
Take the appropriate next action whenever possible (escalate, validate, follow up, or provide an update) instead of repeating the previous response.
Ensure your reply adds value and moves the case forward even if you will change the meaning.
Our goal is to resolve the vendor's concern, not to repeat information that has already been communicated.
Please note that repeating the same response or reusing the same macro without adding value may result in an Agent-Related DSAT and will cause the QA score for this attribute to be 0%.



Amir Ali

Quality Assurance Analyst | Teleperformance | M +01090097684 | Cairo, Egypt | amir.taha@teleperformance.com

Subject: QA Update | HungerStation Markets – Branch Closure Requests
 
Dear Team,
Please be informed of an important update regarding Hunger Station Markets branch closure requests.
Effective immediately, if a Hunger Station Markets partner requests that a branch be temporarily closed and sends an email similar to the example below, the assigned agent must proceed with setting the branch status to Busy through the Operations Portal (OP).
This process should be handled directly by the agent because the Hunger Station Markets team does not have Pelican access to perform this action themselves.
Example of a Hunger Station Markets Request:
Dear Help Team,
Please set the below branch to Busy by Support in the Operations Portal. We currently do not have system access to disable or close it from our end.
  • Branch ID: [Branch ID]
  • Branch Name: HungerStation Market - Al Nada
  • Reason: Temporary closure for stock checking
Please let us know once the status update is complete. Thank you for your assistance!
Required Action:
  1. Verify the branch details provided by the partner.
  2. Set the branch status to Busy in the Operations Portal.
  3. Reply to the partner confirming that the branch has been successfully updated to Busy.


    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

يرجى العلم بوجود تحديث مهم بخصوص طلبات إغلاق فروع HungerStation Markets.
اعتبارًا من الآن، في حال طلب أحد شركاء HungerStation Markets إغلاق فرع بشكل مؤقت وأرسل بريدًا إلكترونيًا مشابهًا للمثال أدناه، يجب على الموظف المسؤول تنفيذ الإجراء مباشرة من خلال Operations Portal (OP) وتغيير حالة الفرع إلى Busy.
يجب أن يتم هذا الإجراء بواسطة الموظف مباشرة، وذلك لأن فريق HungerStation Markets لا يمتلك صلاحية الوصول إلى Pelican لتنفيذ هذا الإجراء من جانبهم.
مثال على طلب من HungerStation Markets:
  ، فريق الدعم المحترم

  •  يرجى التكرم بتغيير حالة الفرع الموضح أدناه إلى مشغول  عبر بوابة الاوبريشن البورتال، حيث لا تتوفر لدينا صلاحية إغلاقه أو تعطيله من جانبنا .
  • رقم الفرع (Branch ID): [رقم الفرع]
  • اسم الفرع: هنقرستيشن ماركت  / الندى
  • السبب: إغلاق مؤقت لإجراء جرد للمخزون
  • يرجى إفادتنا فور إتمام تحديث الحالة. شاكرين ومقدرين لكم حسن تعاونكم!
الإجراء المطلوب:
  1. التحقق من بيانات الفرع المرسلة من قبل الشريك.
  2. تغيير حالة الفرع إلى Busy من خلال Operations Portal (OP).
  3. الرد على الشريك وتأكيد أن حالة الفرع تم تحديثها بنجاح إلى Busy.

subject: Procedure for Handling Nonresponse Vendor Chats

bodies.text:
Dear Team,

 

Kindly note that if a vendor enters the chat and explains their issue, then does not respond again or confirm the order ID, the agent will proceed with taking the necessary action without waiting for further confirmation. The chat will not be closed, and the agent will continue working on the order ID already available in the 1VU system and take the appropriate action accordingly.

 

 

This is for the Nonresponse Chats from vendors :

 

Proceed with the order as it appears on 1VU, even if the vendor does not confirm the order ID.
Provide all relevant order information to the vendor before ending the chat. There is no need to wait for their confirmation.
For example, in Request Rider ETA, you must contact the rider and provide the vendor with the estimated arrival time.
In Product Unavailable chats, inform the vendor to hide the item, etc.
All remaining CCRs should be handled by providing the necessary information to the vendor. Do not send the closure of a silent chat to the vendor until the chat has been properly addressed.

 

This approach will help avoid receiving D-sats from vendors. If a vendor returns to the chat and finds that the agent has already closed it, they may submit a D-sat. Therefore, please ensure that all chats are properly handled and not ignored without a solution and not following the above will score you down in QA score and for the Validation , the D-sat will be remarked as an Agent Related.

 

 

 

 

Amir Ali

Quality Assurance Analyst | Teleperformance | M +01090097684 | Cairo, Egypt | amir.taha@teleperformance.com

Subject: Procedure for Handling Nonresponse Vendor Chats

 

Dear Team,

 

Kindly note that if a vendor enters the chat and explains their issue, then does not respond again or confirm the order ID, the agent will proceed with taking the necessary action without waiting for further confirmation. The chat will not be closed, and the agent will continue working on the order ID already available in the 1VU system and take the appropriate action accordingly.

 

 

This is for the Nonresponse Chats from vendors :

 

  1. Proceed with the order as it appears on 1VU, even if the vendor does not confirm the order ID.
  2. Provide all relevant order information to the vendor before ending the chat. There is no need to wait for their confirmation.
    • For example, in Request Rider ETA, you must contact the rider and provide the vendor with the estimated arrival time.
    • In Product Unavailable chats, inform the vendor to hide the item, etc.
    • All remaining CCRs should be handled by providing the necessary information to the vendor. Do not send the closure of a silent chat to the vendor until the chat has been properly addressed.

 

  • This approach will help avoid receiving D-sats from vendors. If a vendor returns to the chat and finds that the agent has already closed it, they may submit a D-sat. Therefore, please ensure that all chats are properly handled and not ignored without a solution and not following the above will score you down in QA score and for the Validation , the D-sat will be remarked as an Agent Related.

 

 

 

 

Amir Ali

bodies.text:
Dear Team,
Please be informed that the Logistics Team has raised a concern regarding the frequent use of the reassignment reason "Special Vehicle/Equipment Needed" for scenarios where it does not apply.
To ensure accurate reporting and operational tracking, please use the appropriate reassignment reason based on the situation:
1. Rider arrives with a bike while the order requires a car
(Even if the rider is assigned a car in the system but arrives with a bike.)
➝ Order - Special Vehicle/Equipment Needed
2. Rider behavior issues
(e.g., causing trouble at the store, unprofessional behavior, refusing to cooperate, etc.)
➝ Not Accepting
3. Rider is delayed and not responding to agent calls
➝ Not Moving Toward Pickup/Drop-off and Not Reachable
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
نود إحاطتكم علمًا بأن فريق اللوجستيات أبدى ملاحظة بشأن الاستخدام المتكرر لسبب إعادة التعيين "Special Vehicle/Equipment Needed" في حالات لا ينطبق عليها هذا السبب.
لضمان دقة التقارير والمتابعة التشغيلية، يرجى اختيار سبب إعادة التعيين المناسب وفقًا للحالة:
1. وصول المندوب بدراجة نارية بينما الطلب يتطلب سيارة
(حتى وإن كان المندوب مُسجلاً في النظام على أنه يستخدم سيارة ولكنه وصل بدراجة نارية)
➝ Order - Special Vehicle/Equipment Needed
2. وجود مشكلة تتعلق بسلوك المندوب
(مثل التسبب بمشكلة داخل المتجر، أو التصرف بشكل غير مهني، أو رفض التعاون، وغيرها)
➝ Not Accepting
3. تأخر المندوب وعدم الرد على اتصالات الوكيل
➝ Not Moving Toward Pickup/Drop-off and Not Reachable
يرجى التأكد من اختيار سبب إعادة التعيين الصحيح في كل حالة، وذلك للحفاظ على دقة البيانات ودعم التحليل والمتابعة التشغيلية بشكل صحيح.
شكرًا لتعاونكم.



Amir Ali

Quality Assurance Analyst | Teleperformance | M +01090097684 | Cairo, Egypt | amir.taha@teleperformance.com

Subject: Reassignment Reasons | Correct Usage Guidelines | Hurrier
 
Dear Team,
Please be informed that the Logistics Team has raised a concern regarding the frequent use of the reassignment reason "Special Vehicle/Equipment Needed" for scenarios where it does not apply.
To ensure accurate reporting and operational tracking, please use the appropriate reassignment reason based on the situation:
1. Rider arrives with a bike while the order requires a car
(Even if the rider is assigned a car in the system but arrives with a bike.)
➝ Order - Special Vehicle/Equipment Needed
2. Rider behavior issues
(e.g., causing trouble at the store, unprofessional behavior, refusing to cooperate, etc.)
➝ Not Accepting
3. Rider is delayed and not responding to agent calls
➝ Not Moving Toward Pickup/Drop-off and Not Reachable
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
نود إحاطتكم علمًا بأن فريق اللوجستيات أبدى ملاحظة بشأن الاستخدام المتكرر لسبب إعادة التعيين "Special Vehicle/Equipment Needed" في حالات لا ينطبق عليها هذا السبب.
لضمان دقة التقارير والمتابعة التشغيلية، يرجى اختيار سبب إعادة التعيين المناسب وفقًا للحالة:
1. وصول المندوب بدراجة نارية بينما الطلب يتطلب سيارة
(حتى وإن كان المندوب مُسجلاً في النظام على أنه يستخدم سيارة ولكنه وصل بدراجة نارية)
➝ Order - Special Vehicle/Equipment Needed
2. وجود مشكلة تتعلق بسلوك المندوب
(مثل التسبب بمشكلة داخل المتجر، أو التصرف بشكل غير مهني، أو رفض التعاون، وغيرها)
➝ Not Accepting
3. تأخر المندوب وعدم الرد على اتصالات الوكيل
➝ Not Moving Toward Pickup/Drop-off and Not Reachable
يرجى التأكد من اختيار سبب إعادة التعيين الصحيح في كل حالة، وذلك للحفاظ على دقة البيانات ودعم التحليل والمتابعة التشغيلية بشكل صحيح.
شكرًا لتعاونكم.

Hello Team,

 

Regarding the correct handling of Compensation Cases. We have noticed repeated cases where vendors clearly mention that they have already submitted a compensation request, yet agents still resend the compensation steps again to the vendor.

 

To ensure accuracy and avoid vendor frustration, please follow the guideline below :

 

This is a link to check the order status, where you can see if the vendor has been raised before or not. This helps avoid sending the same macro to the vendor repeatedly and allows you to Avoid their D-sats.

 

Link




https://billing.hungerstation.com/operation/en/order_disputes?by_order_id=&by_branch_id=&by_company_id=&by_status=&by_approved_at%5Bstart_date%5D=&by_approved_at%5Bend_date%5D=&commit=apply+filters

 

If the status of the order is Rejected :

 

Aplogize to the vendor
Did not repeat the same macro and steps to the vendor

 

If the Status of the order is Requier Evidence :

 

Request the Evidence from the vendor
Then escalate the case to the dispute team with the evidence of the vendor under CCR : Payment Reconciliation
SLA : As soon as possible

 

Requier Evidence Response

	

طلب تقديم الأدلة رد

	


 

Thank you for reaching out regarding your compensation request. Kindly provide supporting evidence (screenshots, documents, or any proof) for your compensation request so we can process it.

 

	

شكرًا لتواصلك معنا بخصوص طلب التعويض. يرجى تزويدنا بالأدلة الداعمة (لقطات شاشة، مستندات، أو أي إثبات) حتى نتمكن من معالجة طلبك.

 

	
	
	

 

If Evidence Provided :

 

Request Escalation Response

	

رد تحويل الطلب الي القسم

	


Your request has been forwarded to the Dispute Team, and you will receive a response as soon as possible.

 

	

تم تحويل طلبك إلى قسم التحقق من التعويضات وسوف يتم الرد عليك في أقرب وقت ممكن.

 

	
	
	

 

 

Steps :

Open the Link
From ( Filters ) , put the order ID
Click to Apply Filters
Status will appear with the Results of the order

 

 

 

 

Amir Ali

Hello Team,

 

Regarding the correct handling of Compensation Cases. We have noticed repeated cases where vendors clearly mention that they have already submitted a compensation request, yet agents still resend the compensation steps again to the vendor.

 

To ensure accuracy and avoid vendor frustration, please follow the guideline below :

 

  • This is a link to check the order status, where you can see if the vendor has been raised before or not. This helps avoid sending the same macro to the vendor repeatedly and allows you to Avoid their D-sats.

 

Link

https://billing.hungerstation.com/operation/en/order_disputes?by_order_id=&by_branch_id=&by_company_id=&by_status=&by_approved_at%5Bstart_date%5D=&by_approved_at%5Bend_date%5D=&commit=apply+filters

 

If the status of the order is Rejected :

 

  • Aplogize to the vendor
  • Did not repeat the same macro and steps to the vendor

 

If the Status of the order is Requier Evidence :

 

  • Request the Evidence from the vendor
  • Then escalate the case to the dispute team with the evidence of the vendor under CCR : Payment Reconciliation
  • SLA : As soon as possible

 

Requier Evidence Response

طلب تقديم الأدلة رد

 

Thank you for reaching out regarding your compensation request. Kindly provide supporting evidence (screenshots, documents, or any proof) for your compensation request so we can process it.

 

شكرًا لتواصلك معنا بخصوص طلب التعويض. يرجى تزويدنا بالأدلة الداعمة (لقطات شاشة، مستندات، أو أي إثبات) حتى نتمكن من معالجة طلبك.

 

 

If Evidence Provided :

 

Request Escalation Response

رد تحويل الطلب الي القسم

Your request has been forwarded to the Dispute Team, and you will receive a response as soon as possible.

 

تم تحويل طلبك إلى قسم التحقق من التعويضات وسوف يتم الرد عليك في أقرب وقت ممكن.

 

 

 

Steps :

  • Open the Link
  • From ( Filters ) , put the order ID
  • Click to Apply Filters
  • Status will appear with the Results of the order

Subject: Important Update – QR Code Process for Order Pick-Up
 


Dear Team,
For both Rider Care and Partner Care,
Please be informed that a new update has been implemented regarding the rider pick-up process.
Starting now, when the rider arrives to collect the order from the restaurant, a QR Code will appear on the vendor’s side to complete the pick-up.
In case the rider faces any issue scanning the QR Code, kindly guide the vendors to follow the steps below:
Open Order Details from the Active Orders on the printer.
Select “Show QR Code”.
Share the QR Code / PIN with the rider to allow them to pick up the order.
This update is important to ensure a smooth pick-up process and avoid any delays or escalations.




-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
يرجى العلم بأنه تم تطبيق تحديث جديد بخصوص عملية استلام الطلب من قِبل المندوب.
ابتداءً من الآن، عند وصول المندوب لاستلام الطلب من المطعم، سيظهر QR Code لدى البائع لإتمام عملية الاستلام.
وفي حال واجه المندوب أي مشكلة في مسح الـ QR Code، يُرجى إرشاد البائعين لاتّباع الخطوات التالية:
فتح تفاصيل الطلب من الطلبات النشطة على الطابعة
اختيار "Show QR Code"
مشاركة الـ QR Code أو الـ PIN مع المندوب ليتمكّن من استلام الطلب
هذا التحديث مهم لضمان سلاسة عملية الاستلام وتجنّب أي تأخير أو تصعيد.

Subject: Important Update – QR Code Process for Order Pick-Up
 

Dear Team,
For both Rider Care and Partner Care,
Please be informed that a new update has been implemented regarding the rider pick-up process.
Starting now, when the rider arrives to collect the order from the restaurant, a QR Code will appear on the vendor’s side to complete the pick-up.
In case the rider faces any issue scanning the QR Code, kindly guide the vendors to follow the steps below:
  1. Open Order Details from the Active Orders on the printer.
  2. Select “Show QR Code”.
  3. Share the QR Code / PIN with the rider to allow them to pick up the order.
This update is important to ensure a smooth pick-up process and avoid any delays or escalations.


-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
يرجى العلم بأنه تم تطبيق تحديث جديد بخصوص عملية استلام الطلب من قِبل المندوب.
ابتداءً من الآن، عند وصول المندوب لاستلام الطلب من المطعم، سيظهر QR Code لدى البائع لإتمام عملية الاستلام.
وفي حال واجه المندوب أي مشكلة في مسح الـ QR Code، يُرجى إرشاد البائعين لاتّباع الخطوات التالية:
فتح تفاصيل الطلب من الطلبات النشطة على الطابعة
اختيار "Show QR Code"
مشاركة الـ QR Code أو الـ PIN مع المندوب ليتمكّن من استلام الطلب
هذا التحديث مهم لضمان سلاسة عملية الاستلام وتجنّب أي تأخير أو تصعيد.

Habiba Mohamed

Quality Assurance Analyst

subject: Onboarding Cases | Standard Process.

bodies.text:
Dear Team,

This is an urgent reminder for everyone handling onboarding cases. These are critical cases and must strictly follow the standard process.

I’d like to share with you the correct process for handling and resolving tickets received from the Onboarding Team :

 

Check the ticket details carefully
At the top of each ticket, you’ll find the Grid, Vendor name. The first step is to make sure to add the Correct Vendor ID.

 

Contact the vendor
Each ticket contains a phone number for the vendor. We must call the vendor to check the issue and resolve it directly.
If the vendor does not answer, we should resolve the issue through the Macro reply.

 

Include the ticket number
At the end of the macro, make sure to mention the Ticket ID clearly.

 

Always add the vendor’s email
The vendor’s email should be taken from the Operation Portal. If you send your reply without including the vendor’s email, your response will not reach him.

 

The three Onboarding Team emails are : ( When they send a ticket, they usually put the Hungerstation client email as well )

Malak.alshawabkeh.ext@hungerstation.com
Kayed.khraisat.ext@hungerstation.com
Salahaldeen.aldebei.ext@hungerstation.com



 

Please note that failure to adhere to the above will result in a 0% deduction in the QA score. 

 




Amir Ali

Quality Assurance Analyst | Teleperformance | M +01090097684 | Cairo, Egypt | amir.taha@teleperformance.com
